decision: Do not integrate or promote this fixed gate: bright-color mean improvement trades against increased spatial variation and five flat-grid group regressions. No meaningful detail gain in reviewed photos/GFX. Finish the already-running predeclared CPU screen; do not tune thresholds/windows on these observations.

fixed_policy.sensor_support: 66 native pixels; actual in-bounds per-color counts, both greens pooled
fixed_policy.shared_gate: minimum across all RGB flatness gates; zero if any window sensor sample clips white
fixed_policy.correction: Input-minus-predicted observed-CFA mean, multiplied by input-only flatness gate and smoothly expanded to native grid
fixed_policy.acceptance_before_scores: Neither fixed photo nor any of four selected uniform fields may worsen cameraRGB RMSE. Failure rejects this fixed pilot without parameter tuning or model integration.
fixed_policy.scope: Motivated small diagnostic; existing exact saved V60 CPU predictions, no new neural inference/training/GPU/RAW decode, no target-dependent method or blind-quality claim. Exact unclipped-PG moment variance is not a confidence guarantee or unbiased-restoration theorem.

result.scope: Arithmetic/oracle/limiting cases only; no neural inference, trained quality, exact statistical tail coverage or unbiased noisy restoration claim.
